title: Document
description: A whole document: canvas, imported assets, and the layer stack.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this document, independent of the release version.

version.description:
How many mutations this document has had.

A caller that read the document at version 7 sends 7 back with its
next mutation; if the document has moved on, the mutation is refused
rather than silently overwriting someone else's work (PRD §10.3).

canvas.description: Canvas the layers are composed on.

assets.description: Assets imported into the project, referenced by image layers.

layers.description: Layers, bottom first: array order is z-order.

presets.description:
Named style bundles this document offers.

In the document rather than beside the workspace, so that a project
directory stays portable and the same document cannot render
differently depending on what else is installed next to it — see
[`crate::presets`]. Additive with a default, like every field added
since schema version 1.

slots.description:
Named openings a caller may fill, making this document a template
(PRD use case C). Empty for an ordinary document.

Additive with a default, like every other field added since schema
version 1: a build that does not know about slots preserves them, and
a document without them loads here unchanged.

Canvas.description: The fixed-size surface layers are composed on.

width.description: Width in pixels; must be positive and finite.

height.description: Height in pixels; must be positive and finite.

Color.description:
An sRGB colour, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`.

Stored as written so a document round-trips exactly; validation checks the
shape and [`Color::to_rgba`] parses it.

Asset.description: An imported file living under the project's `assets/` directory.

path.description: Path relative to the project's `assets/` directory, `/`-separated.

hash.description: Content hash of the file, `sha256:<hex>`. Detects silent edits.

Layer.description: One layer: the properties every layer has, plus its kind-specific payload.

transform.description: Placement in the parent's coordinate space.

visible.description: Whether the layer is rendered at all.

locked.description:
Whether editing tools should refuse to move this layer.

The user-facing "don't let me nudge this by accident" flag. An
explicit override can still change it (PRD §10.2).

protected.description:
Whether AI adapters and agents may change this layer at all.

Unlike `locked`, there is no override: a protected layer is refused
for every mutation, whoever asks (PRD §10.2, MVP criterion 11).

readOnly.description: Whether the layer is inspectable but never mutable through the API.

blendMode.description:
Reserved (v0.5): only `normal` is rendered today; other values
round-trip but do not yet change output.

effects.description:
Adjustments applied to this layer when it is drawn, in order.

**Never baked.** The document keeps the numbers and the pixels are
derived from them every render, so an effect is as reversible as any
other property and a layer under three effects is still the layer.

Always written, even when empty, exactly as it has been since schema
version 1: omitting it would change the bytes of every document that
has one, for no gain.

constraints.description: Reserved (layout constraints): preserved verbatim, never interpreted.

oneOf.description: A run of text in a single style.
A container transforming its children as a unit.
An imported vector graphic, drawn into the layer box.

Transform.description: Position, size, and rotation of a layer in its parent's coordinate space.

width.description: Box width; must be finite and not negative.

height.description: Box height; must be finite and not negative.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees about the box centre.

BlendMode.description:
How a layer composites onto what is beneath it.

The whole CSS separable-and-non-separable set, every one of which was
checked to rasterize before it was named here — a mode that only
round-trips would be a promise the pixels do not keep.

[`BlendMode::Other`] is what a mode written by some newer build becomes:
preserved verbatim, because losing it would mean a document came back
damaged, but **refused at render time** rather than quietly composited as
`normal`. Silently drawing the wrong thing is the worse failure: it looks
like it worked.

anyOf.description: Plain source-over compositing.
Darkens: multiplies the two colours.
Lightens: the inverse of multiplying the inverses.
Multiplies or screens, depending on the backdrop.
Keeps the darker of the two.
Keeps the lighter of the two.
Brightens the backdrop to reflect the source.
Darkens the backdrop to reflect the source.
`Overlay` with the layers swapped.
A softer `HardLight`.
The absolute difference of the two.
Like `Difference`, with less contrast.
The source's hue, the backdrop's saturation and luminosity.
The source's saturation, the backdrop's hue and luminosity.
The source's hue and saturation, the backdrop's luminosity.
The source's luminosity, the backdrop's hue and saturation.

A mode this build does not render, preserved as written and refused
when something tries to draw it.

Effect.description:
One adjustment in a layer's effect stack.

Tagged by `type`, so the JSON reads as what it is. [`Effect::Other`] keeps
an effect written by a newer build verbatim and refuses to render it —
the same bargain as [`BlendMode::Other`]: never lose it, never guess at it.

The amounts are multipliers where 1 means "unchanged", which is what
`filter: brightness(1.2)` means everywhere else, so a number copied from a
CSS example does what it looks like it does.

anyOf.description: Scales each channel. 1 is unchanged, 0 is black.
Pushes each channel away from mid grey. 1 is unchanged, 0 is flat grey.
Scales colourfulness. 1 is unchanged, 0 is greyscale.
A Gaussian blur.

radius.description: Standard deviation, in document units. 0 does nothing.

anyOf.description:
Seeded monochrome noise, multiplied over the layer.

The seed is part of the document, not the run: the same document
produces the same grain on every machine and in every render (NFR-3).
Grain from a clock or a random number generator would quietly break
the one property this project is built on.

amount.description: How far the noise swings either side of unchanged, 0 to 1.

scale.description: Size of the noise features; 1 is fine grain, larger is coarser.

anyOf.description:
An effect this build does not know, preserved as written and refused
when something tries to draw it.

TextAlign.description: Horizontal text alignment inside the layer box.

TextLayer.description: Text content and its single style. Per-run styling arrives in v2.0.

text.description: The text. `\n` starts a new line.

fontFamily.description: Font family name, resolved against the caller's font set.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels; must be positive and finite.

align.description: Horizontal alignment within the layer box.

lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size.

runs.description: Reserved (v2.0 styled runs): preserved verbatim, never interpreted.

ImageFit.description: How an image is scaled into its box.

oneOf.description: Stretch to the box, ignoring aspect ratio.
Scale down to fit inside the box, keeping aspect ratio.
Scale to cover the box, keeping aspect ratio, cropping the overflow.

ImageLayer.description: A reference to an imported asset, drawn into the layer box.

asset.description: Id of an asset in the document's `assets` list.

fit.description: How the image fills its box.

GroupLayer.description: A group of layers, transformed as a unit.

children.description: Children, bottom first, positioned relative to the group.

SvgLayer.description:
A reference to an imported SVG asset, drawn into the layer box.

Separate from [`ImageLayer`] because an SVG is vector: it scales without
loss, and it went through the import sanitiser (`crate::svg_import`) before
it was stored. Nothing in a project's `assets/` directory carries scripts
or external references.

asset.description: Id of an asset in the document's `assets` list.

fit.description: How the graphic fills its box.

Preset.description: A named bundle of style properties.

name.description: What it is called. Unique within a document.

description.description:
What it is for, for whoever is choosing between presets — including an
agent, which is the case that needs it most.

properties.description: The properties it sets. Anything left out is left alone on apply.

PresetProperties.description:
What a preset sets.

Every field optional, and absent means "leave alone" — so a preset that
only names a colour is a colour preset, and applying it does not quietly
reset a layer's font.

Deliberately no transform: a style is not a position. A preset that moved
layers would be a template, and templates already exist.

effects.description: Any layer: the whole effect stack.

Slot.description: A named opening in a template.

name.description: What a caller names this slot by. Unique within a document.

kind.description: What may be supplied for it.

description.description:
What this slot is for, for whoever is filling it — including an agent,
which is the case that needs it most.

required.description: Whether a variant must supply it.

SlotKind.description: What a slot lets a caller supply.

oneOf.description: The text of a text layer.
The asset an image layer draws.
The fill colour of a text layer.
